preconditions.name: modulatory_range_supra_floor
preconditions.description: gate's true cross-candidate modulatory range (modulatory_authority_range) clears the floor -- the SAME RANGE statistic C1 (and thus the C2a authority precondition) gates on; NOT a magnitude proxy
preconditions.control: ON arms, ticks with >= 2 first-action classes

preconditions.name: primary_scores_bounded
preconditions.description: fraction of ON-arm P1 ticks with e3_raw_score_range_mean < 1000.0 -- non-vacuity guard

preconditions.name: authority_active_on_positive_control
preconditions.description: authority FIRES on the ON arms (modulatory_authority_active_frac > AUTHORITY_ACTIVE_FRAC_FLOOR) -- the readiness precondition for the C2a flip-rate criterion, asserting the SAME count/frequency kind of statistic C2a routes on (NOT a magnitude). If the authority never fires, the ON-arm flip rate is meaningless -> substrate_not_ready_requeue

grid.substrate_not_ready_requeue: readiness fails (modulatory_range below floor OR scores unbounded) -- stabilize, NOT a falsification.
grid.authority_carves_selection_dose_responsi: C2a PASS + C2b dose-response holds: authority carves committed selection AND more gain carves more. Full validation.
grid.authority_carves_selection_dose_flat_nea: C2a PASS + C2b dose FLAT: authority carves committed selection at a non-trivial but NEAR-TIE-BOUND rate; higher gain does NOT carve more (the env near-tie frequency, not the gain, sets the flip rate). NOT remedied by higher gain. Rescaling-vs-native isolation deferred to the clean-later ree_core-diagnostic + re-mint pass.
grid.authority_active_but_no_selection_change: C1 PASS but C2a FAIL: the authority fires but never changes the committed choice -- genuine impotence; escalate to the clean-later rescaling-isolation pass.
grid.authority_does_not_fire_on_bounded_real_: readiness met but C1 fails -- the gate does not fire on a real bounded range; /diagnose-errors on the rescale arithmetic.
